form-engine.core.lint.cycle: The fields read each other in a loop: {path}
form-engine.core.lint.data-source: The data source "{id}" must call an address inside this system, not "{url}"
form-engine.core.lint.data-source-unlist: The data source "{id}" calls "{url}", which no module lists as allowed
form-engine.core.lint.duplicate-option: Two options have the same value "{value}"
form-engine.core.lint.key-missing: The key "{key}" ({label}) was published and cannot be deleted: mark it removed instead
form-engine.core.lint.key-moved: The key "{key}" moved into or out of a repeatable section
form-engine.core.lint.key-retyped: The key "{key}" held {was} and now holds {now}: a published key keeps its kind
form-engine.core.lint.reads-removed: It reads "{key}", which was removed from the form
form-engine.core.lint.required-hideable: This required field can be hidden and starts empty: it may block the form
form-engine.core.lint.too-many-fields: The form has {count} fields; at most {max} are allowed
form-engine.core.lint.unknown-option: It compares "{field}" with "{value}", which is not one of its options
form-engine.core.lint.unknown-reference: It reads "{ref}", which is not a field of this form
form-engine.core.lint.unreachable: This field can never be shown: its visibility rules cannot all hold
form-engine.core.lint.untranslated: Texts missing in a required language: {count} (missing: {languages})
form-engine.core.tests.errorUnexpected: "{path}" fails, but the case does not expect it
form-engine.core.tests.expectedInvalid: The case should be refused, but the form accepts it
form-engine.core.tests.expectedValid: The case should be valid, but the form refuses it
form-engine.core.tests.invalidCase: This is not a valid test case
form-engine.core.tests.valueDiffers: The submitted value of "{path}" is not the expected one
form-engine.core.validation.chooseOption: Please choose one of the options
form-engine.core.validation.email: Please enter a valid email address
form-engine.core.validation.invalidRefer: Choose a record from the list
form-engine.core.validation.minItems: {label}: at least {count, plural, one {{count} row} other {{count} rows}} required
form-engine.core.lint.unclassified: "{field}" has no data class: the browser keeps no draft of its answer, and it counts as personal elsewhere. Mark a phone, a FIN or a medical result as sensitive.
form-engine.core.lint.sensitive-filterab: "{field}" is sensitive: it cannot be filterable (filtering on it would tell its value).
